Adoption Plan

Sits on top of existing systems — nothing to rip out

Week 0CSV import of registers, hostel rosters, fee sheets (Migration page). Parallel-run with paper.
Week 1Pilot in ONE hostel: 2 wardens + 10 student volunteers, SMS fallback on.
Week 2Replace WhatsApp notice groups for one department; WhatsApp-export importer for history.
Week 3Gate pass + mess feedback for all hostels; kiosks in common rooms.
Week 4Campus-wide. Attendance connects to the existing biometric API (read-only) instead of replacing it.

Data needed

Student roster (name, roll, branch, year, phone, hostel/room) · staff & department mapping · timetable · fee heads · mess menu · building/room list · a campus 3D/GLB or floor plan.

Habit migration

SMS fallback = nobody excluded. Warden resolution score in monthly reports. Students see status without asking. Offline-first = no downtime when the network drops.

SMS & IVR Fallback

For students without a smartphone or on patchy networks — all core flows work via SMS or missed-call IVR.

SMS COMMANDS
ATT → Check attendance
TICKET <issue> → Raise complaint
CERT <type> → Request certificate
MENU → Today's mess menu
MISSED-CALL IVR
Give a missed call to 1800-CAMPUS-OS
Follow voice prompts · Works on any phone
✓ 186 students currently using SMS fallback · 24 using IVR
